channel.title: West Hawaii Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from West Hawaii Today (westhawaiitoday.com)

item.title: Trump announces he is replacing Noem with Oklahoma senator
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump fired his embattled homeland security secretary, Kristi Noem, on Thursday and announced plans to replace her with Sen. Markwayne Mullin of Oklahoma, after she was grilled by Republican lawmakers this week at congressional hearings on a variety of topics, including her knowledge of a contract with a politically connected firm.

item.title: States sue to stop Trump from reviving steep tariffs
item.description: WASHINGTON — A coalition of two dozen states sued President Donald Trump on Thursday over the new 10% tariff that he has imposed on imports from around the world, a move that will send the administration back to court to defend the legality of its punishing trade war.

item.title: Nature report, killed by Trump, is released independently
item.description: Scientists and other experts were preparing a first-of-its-kind assessment of the health of nature in the United States when President Donald Trump returned to the White House.

item.title: Dozens of medical schools back Kennedy plan on nutrition after pressure
item.description: Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. said Thursday that more than 50 medical schools would embrace a federal framework for nutrition education, after a monthslong campaign to pressure universities into accepting the government’s curriculum recommendations.

item.title: Israel begins assault in Southern Beirut, raising fears of wider incursion
item.description: BEIRUT — An Israeli order for residents to “save your lives and evacuate your homes immediately” brought chaos to the suburbs of Beirut on Thursday and was punctuated hours later with a bombing campaign by Israeli warplanes that raised fears of a new front in the metastasizing Middle East war.

item.title: Bill to put math coaches in schools advances
item.description: A bill advancing at the state Capitol would establish a statewide numeracy coaching program in Hawaii public schools, as lawmakers and education officials grapple with persistent gaps in math achievement.

item.title: Trump tells Reuters US must have a role in choosing Iran’s next leader
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump told Reuters on Thursday the United States must be involved in choosing the next leader of Iran and said it would be “wonderful” if Iranian Kurdish forces based in Iraq were to cross into Iran to launch attacks on security forces there.

item.title: State Department is accused of slow assistance for stranded Americans
item.description: WASHINGTON — The State Department is battling accusations from diplomats and travelers who say the Trump administration endangered U.S. citizens in the Middle East by beginning a war against Iran without adequate plans for helping Americans leave the region.

item.title: US investigation points to likely US responsibility in Iran school strike, sources say
item.description: U.S. military investigators believe it is likely that U.S. forces were responsible for an apparent strike on an Iranian girls’ school that killed scores of children on Saturday but have not yet reached a final conclusion or completed their investigation, two U.S. officials told Reuters.

item.title: New Hawaii pilot program aims to curb evictions, keep disputes out of court
item.description: A new statewide pre-eviction mediation law that went into effect last month has already had success in keeping Hawaii Island tenants in their homes.
